answer: An identity must show a hackathon record: projects built in public, demos recorded, and prizes or participation archived across events. A bridge is built plank by plank, and a hackathon record is built project by project. The ferrous frame of a farm's record bends easily: their projects are all forks of the same template, submitted to the same events, by the same people under new names. A cedar grows for decades, and so does a real builder's record: the network trusts the builder whose projects span years, not the one whose history starts last weekend.
